description.en: Forces the outcome of clashes involving a given team/player to always fail (or, when disabled, stops forcing it) — the losing counterpart to CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN.
True to force losses, false to stop forcing them.
Team ID (when called with 3-4 arguments) or a character ID string (when called with exactly 2 arguments).
Optional player number within the team; only used in the 3-4 argument forms.
Optional extra mode parameter; only used in the 4-argument form.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Force team 1's player 0 to always lose their clashes for this scripted match
CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_LOSE(true, 1, 0, true);
